purpose: One frozen Train-inner confirmation block for the existing barrier-value GRU; diagnostic only, not independent OOS or promotion evidence.

fit.purge_rule: Every training path label ends before the evaluation start.

evaluation.reentry_rule: Reenter only at the next five-minute decision strictly after the exit bar.
evaluation.other_thresholds: May be emitted as descriptive diagnostics only; do not select or tune from them.

model.type: GRU direct long-short net path value regression
model.features: causal v6 16 features plus 3 causal kline flow features

path_and_cost_assumptions.base_sensitivity_method: Add 18 bps per same fixed trade; do not change model predictions or entries.

screen_rule: Keep the frozen candidate only if the primary threshold produces at least 30 sequential trades, positive stress net mean, and positive net means in both predeclared three-day subperiods. A pass permits a separately frozen native Train-inner screen only; it is not promotion or profitability certification.
failure_rule: If the screen rule fails, reject this frozen recipe. Do not change thresholds, labels, features, or windows in response to this block.
